messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English between two adult friends after one of them has received difficult personal news. Keep the emotional response restrained and believable. Let the scene rely on pauses, practical behavior, unfinished sentences, and simple support rather than dramatic speeches. Do not name or explain the full emotion directly.

Sam sat at the kitchen table with the phone still in his hand.

Riley put a glass of water beside him.

“You should drink something.”

Sam nodded.

He didn't reach for it.

Riley sat across from him.

“What did they say?”

Sam looked at the table.

“Not much.”

“That usually means too much.”

A small breath escaped him. It wasn't quite a laugh.

“Yeah.”

Riley waited.

Sam finally picked up the glass and took a sip.

“They want me to come in tomorrow.”

“Okay.”

“I don't want to.”

“You don't have to decide that tonight.”

Sam nodded again.

His phone buzzed.

He looked at the screen and turned it facedown.

Riley reached across the table and moved the phone farther away.

Sam watched her do it.

“Thanks.”

“Sure.”

Neither spoke for a while.

The refrigerator clicked on. A car went past outside, then another.

Sam rubbed both hands over his face.

“I don't know what I'm supposed to do next.”

“You don't have to know yet.”

“That sounds nice.”

“It wasn't meant to sound nice.”

Sam looked up.

Riley shrugged. “It's just true.”

He stared at her for a moment, then nodded.

“Can you stay?”

“Yeah.”

“Okay.”

Riley leaned back in her chair.

“Want food?”

Sam thought about it.

“Maybe later.”

“Okay.”

She stayed where she was.

A few minutes passed.

Sam picked up the glass again.

This time, he finished it.
